thread: Arthas heard the warning and chose the orc war: his letter to the King and his promised visit to Andorhal

evidence.clue: Arthas hears Jaina's case in the open at the Strahnbrad hedge. He says 'I don't doubt you' and later 'I believe you', but looks past her to the smoke on the eastern hills each time she presses. She asks for men to shut the Andorhal granaries.

His reason: the Garrow farm (old Garrow, his daughter, her two boys; he ate at their table, helped carry them out yesterday), burned by a band 'out of the camps, with axes'. 'I can see that from my tent door. I can't see your grain.' Men in his camp have families on farms in the raiders' path.

His offer: 'write it down. All of it, just as you've told me. I'll send it to my father tonight with my own rider. He'll put it in front of the council... As soon as these hills are quiet I'll be in Andorhal, and you can show me what you've found.' 'Get something to eat before you go.' Sylvanas had called it: 'He's going to write to his father, Proudmoore, and then he's going back up that hill.' 'Yes. I am.'
He never takes the paper. A rider arrives from the east at a canter; Arthas puts on his helmet and goes up the lane; officers step into the space he left.

Jaina does not write the letter (her hand cannot) and declines the meal. She tells herself the letter will go north tonight, a council will sit, and Antonidas does not know where she is: nobody behind her is coming.

readerKnows: Arthas believes the warning and will not act on it until the hills are quiet; a letter to Terenas goes north tonight; Arthas intends to come to Andorhal later.
povCharacterKnows: Jaina: the above, and that Sylvanas was right about the army. Sylvanas: he is a good commander fighting the wrong war for this. Neither knows how long the hills will take.
notes: Arthas must stay recognisably reasonable: the orc dead are real. Do not turn him into a villain. His arrival in Andorhal is promised, not scheduled. Jaina's private camp memory is the bridge to the Arthas arc (the price is told at sea in Ch19 per plan).
